summary: Actual IAB playback started and advanced, but continuous attempts stalled at 4.3262 seconds, 8.681073 seconds, and 161.089563 seconds after seeking to 156. The media element reported readyState 2 and error null. Seeking to 42, 156 and 193 seconds displayed decoded frames with readyState 4; a real browser-player guard screenshot was saved. Full continuous playback to 195 seconds was not verified. Both final MP4s separately passed complete FFmpeg decoding; this does not substitute for continuous-browser-playback evidence. Windows QA also encountered WinError 1455; the exact cause of browser stalls remains unconfirmed.
